nextRunsTz: Times shown in the hub's timezone: {tz}
cronTooFrequent: This cron can run more often than once an hour, which is not allowed here.
retentionHint: Whichever limit is reached first applies. The newest backup is always kept.
overBudget: Over budget: only the newest backups are left, and they alone exceed the limit.
unknownSize: {count} backup(s) have no recorded size and are not counted.
walNotCounted: The size limit covers dumps and volume archives only. WAL and base backups follow PITR retention and are not counted.
